messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v2.4.1 at 22:00 UTC within tonight's change window. Need API / runtime / console / router aligned, last-minute metrics check, and release notes sync. I'm going to pin api/runtime/console/router -> v2.4.1 and request a small canary. deploybot — can you prepare the canary with a traffic cushion?

samir: Ack. What are the canary thresholds and the metrics we should watch?

maria: Canary plan: start at 5% -> 25% over ~15–20m, hold for 15m at 25%. Watch P50/P95 latency, 5xx error rate, token-cost anomaly. Traffic cushion = reserve 2 extra GPU capacity in dedicated pool for rollback headroom. Rollback criteria need to be explicit.

deploybot: Deploy request accepted. Starting canary rollout for: api:v2.4.1, runtime:v2.4.1, console:v2.4.1, router:v2.4.1. Initial stage=5% for 900s. Pin applied to these services. Automatic rollback triggers configured: error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR P95 increase >200ms vs baseline.

oliver: Console team ready — release notes published and linked in the internal docs. Also adding a manual quick-rollback toggle to the console UI. Docs: https://internal/docs/releases/v2.4.1 (please don't open outside infra).

jen: Runtime update: kernel selection change in this build — we removed the legacy quant path for speed. Added a fallback to quant-legacy in the runtime orchestrator in case of regressions. Please call this out in the notes: "fallback path enabled if perf regresses."

samir: I'll add a temporary alert for KV-cache miss spikes and token-cost anomalies. Runbook snippet: `if kv_miss_rate > 3% for 5m -> pause canary and escalate to eng-runtime`. Also adding a short-playbook to the canary dashboard.

console-oncall-bot: Telemetry check: dashboards deployed for canary (canary latency, errors, kv-miss, token-cost). Alerts routed to #eng-oncall and #incidents.

maria: Good. Manual ops plan: I'll hold the increase at 25% and watch the dashboards. Post-deploy smoke commands (run after we reach 25% and acceptance): `curl -sS https://api.internal/health | jq .` and `ssh runtime-01 -- sudo /opt/bin/check-kv-cache.sh`.

oliver: Change window reminder — we have +2h after cut. Final unpin/rollback decision at +90m if things are stable; otherwise rollback earlier. Rollback steps (for clarity): 1) call `/internal/rollback?release=v2.4.1` 2) revert pins in the orchestrator 3) scale down new kernel pools and drain new nodes 4) notify #eng-releases and affected owners.

samir: On it. I'll post status updates every 5 minutes during canary. If I see kv miss >3% or p95 jump >200ms I'll pause and tag runtime owners.

maria: Thanks — initiating now. deploybot, start canary. :rocket:

deploybot: Canary initiated at 1728888888. Monitoring URL: https://telemetry/internal/canary/1728888888. ETA to 25% ~= 20m. Pin notes saved. Good luck! :thumbsup:
